_comment: Can be won over: a tamable creature comes to whoever holds what it wants (`art/temptations.json`), a bow for a
skeleton, gold for a piglin, and will not attack them while they hold it. Given it, one in three is tamed, and
follows its owner, fights for them and never turns on them. `tamable monsters` is a country of pets in waiting;
laid bare, every creature in the Age is.
